checks.name: ordered application despite arbitrary download order and duplicate delivery
a missing commit prevents the full cursor from advancing
tombstone and newer recent data survive a late baseline block
identity consolidation is one atomic change group
same commit or entity revision with different content is rejected
record, pending change and parser cursor commit or abort together
sealing an old revision does not erase a newer pending revision
live and history acknowledgement frontiers are independent
turn membership expansion handles explicit arrival and withdrawal

limitations: In-memory state model only; does not validate operating-system crashes, database durability or network transport.
Uses already assigned canonical identities and revisions; does not prove provenance discovery or fuzzy matching correctness.
Full feed modeled with dense per-dataset commit sequence; a sparse storage sequence needs explicit scanned-through and predecessor coverage.
Cloning maps models an atomic transaction and is not the proposed production data structure or performance algorithm.
